name: High Judiciary & Galactic Tribunal
role: Highest adjudicative authority of the Galactic Union and superior court for Union constitutional, interstellar, appellate, and extraordinary matters.
jurisdiction: Final or superior Union jurisdiction over constitutional disputes, interstellar law, war crimes, AI rights, appeals from deployed and planetary Union courts, and review of matters lawfully reaching the Union judiciary.

authority_model.trial_relationship: Trial-level proceedings are ordinarily conducted by planetary, sector, specialist, or deployed Union courts, including the Judicator Prime Field Court.
authority_model.appellate_relationship: Receives appeals and extraordinary review from the Judicator Prime Field Court and other lawfully subordinate Union courts.
authority_model.planetary_relationship: May bind planetary courts in matters within Union jurisdiction; enforcement can be resisted by breakaway factions or authorities outside effective Union reach.
authority_model.judicial_council_relationship: The Judicial Council administers appointments, warrants, oversight, and judiciary operations; the High Judiciary & Galactic Tribunal is the superior adjudicative body and does not take case outcomes from the Council.
authority_model.independence: Judicial outcomes are not subordinate to the Chancellor, Union Senate, Fleet Command, Union Marshals, Sentinel High Command, or task-force command.

source_refs.note: Owner-established scope: highest legal authority for interstellar law, constitutional disputes, war crimes, and AI rights.

notes: Entity closes the previously documented structural gap. Exact bench composition, appointment rules for Tribunal members, seat location, internal chambers, and named incumbents remain open until separately admitted.
